end.line: Quillon for Solent Shipping’s legal team

vo: Solent Shipping has five lawyers for a hundred and twenty charter parties a year. Here is that work in Quillon.
For a demurrage dispute, Quillon builds the chronology from the exhibits, and every event links back to its source.
Vault reads every charter party at once, so the laytime clauses on each broker form come back in one table.
Ask how laytime runs under a given charter, and the answer comes back cited to the page.
Anna will walk your team through it on Thursday the twelfth.
